Title: Vihaan and the Family

Cast

1. Vihaan - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Zoya - 11 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Anjali - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Siya - 9 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Zoya stands in the living room. Vihaan, Anjali and Siya stand near her.]

Siya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Zoya puts on red lipstick.]

Anjali: "That's easy."

[Vihaan gulps down a glass of milk.]

Vihaan: "Mom, look at this."

[Vihaan types on his laptop.]

Zoya (excited): "One more time!"

[Vihaan lies down on the sofa.]

Anjali: "What next?"

[Vihaan knocks on the door.]

Zoya: "Okay, Vihaan."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Zoya stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Let's begin."

[Vihaan trips over a stone.]

Vihaan: "What next?"

[Vihaan hurts his knee.]

Vihaan: "Zoya, listen!"

[Vihaan helps Mother get up.]

Anjali: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Vihaan sneezes loudly.]

Vihaan: "That was such a fun day!"
